dogecoin.text: @dogecoin_empire Until I turned 40.  I couldn't do anything to get a woman to even chat with me. As soon as I turned 40, I felt like I was beating them off of me on a daily basis. Turning 40 might be a good thing.

@dogecoin_empire You have spoken the truth!  God's word is true.  Did you know that today you would write down words of prophecy! Thank you for sharing the Word with such liberating truth of power and love!
